roof-finishes.detail: Houses per finish (a house counts once per finish it uses): roofs[].finish, else the form (gable and hip → shingle, shed and pent → standing seam, terracotta → clay tile, flat → membrane).

roof-composition.detail: Roofs with per-end forms, per-face pitches, sweeps, glazed or open gables, planted surfaces, skylights, dormer styles, coloured trim or soffit, gable cladding, chimney material or cap (S2 fields).

room-finishes.value: 0 % of rooms name a floor, 0 % a wall finish, 0 % a ceiling; median 0 floor kinds a house
room-finishes.detail: 490 rooms across 30 houses. Under defaults: 2 (0 houses today) a room with none gets a seeded program-appropriate floor, so this counts what the specs say, not what builds; fleet-audit --built reads the resolved finishes from plan.json's arch.rooms.

facade-vocabulary.value: 0 of 30 houses use S2 facade vocabulary; median 0 kinds a house
facade-vocabulary.detail: Kinds a house says it has: porch, bay, balcony, terrace, loggia, fireplace, built-ins, facade zones, per-volume cladding, plinth, stoop, shutters, window boxes, surrounds, canopies, towers, turning stairs, double-height rooms.

furniture-repetition.value: 46 types in 20 or more houses; the top 12 are 985 of 4052 items
furniture-repetition.detail: 164 item types in use over 4052 room items (the hero desk set left out), 0 of them composed at build time (plan.compose; none in the 30 real specs, which carry no program). Measured against the baseline (test/fleet/baseline.json, the hand-authored fleet at S0). The dry run — every room composed — is the next metric.

composed-repetition.value: 62 % down (343 → 131 house-uses of the authored top 12); 31 → 2 furniture types in 20+ houses
composed-repetition.detail: Furniture is what a room is furnished with (fitted units, appliances, bath fittings, lamps, ceiling fixtures and the Core's desk set left out: a house needs a toilet and a range whatever the composer does). House-uses: the houses using each type. Authored top 12: wall-art 30, runner-rug 30, loveseat 30, snake-plant 29, vase 29, bath-mat 29, wingback-armchair 29, nightstand 28, dresser 28, dining-chair 27, side-table 27, console-table 27. The same twelve, composed: wall-art 13, runner-rug 16, loveseat 0, snake-plant 22, vase 14, bath-mat 10, wingback-armchair 8, nightstand 11, dresser 9, dining-chair 8, side-table 12, console-table 8. The composed fleet's own top 12: framed-print 22, snake-plant 22, ceramic-bowl 19, open-shelving 18, ladder-shelf 18, candelabra 18, plant-stand 17, chest-of-drawers 17, armoire 17, flatweave-rug 16, runner-rug 16, coat-rack 16 (216 house-uses). Every type, as the S0 metric counts them: the top 12 hold 985 authored items and 463 composed ones.

furniture-variety.value: sofas 2 → 6 · sectionals 0 → 3 · armchairs 4 → 8 · dining tables 2 → 6 · dining chairs 1 → 5 · floor plants 6 → 12
furniture-variety.detail: Types in use across the 30 houses, per composer role: the hand-authored fleet, then the dry run (every room composed from its name). The share is the most-used type's houses over the 30.

palette-spread.value: wall 25 distinct · trim 16 distinct · roof 16 distinct · door 12 distinct
palette-spread.detail: Pairwise CIEDE2000 across the houses. Wall: the palette as built (kit-rules.ts kitPalette: restraint, palette.keep). Roof: the largest roof, its own colour or the per-type default, after roofMaterial's restraint and charcoal pull (keep, roofPull, defaults 2). Door: the entry leaf (its colour, palette.door, the defaults-2 timber-or-trim rule, else teal; cased openings and sliders have no leaf).

door-colours.value: 12 distinct leaf colours (0 of 14 leaves are the default teal)
door-colours.detail: Entries without a leaf: 1 cased, 15 slider.

claddings.value: median 1 (0 of 30 houses declare 2 or more)
claddings.detail: Rendered (kind, colour) claddings a house: the house's own, each storey's own (levels[].material; levels[].wallColor under defaults 2), and S2's footprint[] / facade[] zones as they land.

lighting-share.value: top preset day 73 %, top sun bucket 210° 73 %
lighting-share.detail: 0 specs name their preset by a legacy alias. Sun bearings are compass degrees (0 north). Without lighting.sunBearing the sun stands at the entry's bearing plus the preset's swing, so houses whose entries face one way share one sun per preset — unless defaults 2 gives each its seeded swing.

planting-types.detail: Houses using each planting type, and how many items of it. S4's `planting` generator (mix, layers) reports here as it lands.

front-garden-beds.detail: `garden-beds` (raised vegetable crates) between the entry facade and the street.

axis-aligned-edges.detail: Bed outlines and path centre lines on the real lots, by length. Judged as an eye judges it — over 1.5 m chords, not the 0.25 m samples a curve is resampled to: a chord within 3° of the x or z axis that is also straight (under 9 cm of sag) is axis-aligned, so a wobble of a centimetre between samples does not hide a straight edge. Measured as built on 30 of 30 houses (their plan's site.edges: curves resolved, plantings laid out, a bed's edge against the house left out). The last column names the straight items to bend: a `meander` (a sway in metres) or waypoints with `smooth`.
